resources.string: You can still read your chats and manage AI settings. Try sending a new message later.
Ask a question. For help with your marks, timetable or a test, choose the school information to share first.
Review how your data is shared with AI and give your consent before sending.
Your previous reply is still being checked. Check its status before sending another message.
The selected action or its Compute cost has changed. Check the updated cost before sending again.
The status of your previous reply couldn’t be checked. Try checking again later.
Support Gradey for more Compute each day.

Your prompts, recent chat history, and limited school context are sent securely through Firebase Functions to Microsoft Azure AI. Your school credentials and raw school-provider payloads are never sent.
Gradey uses Google Firebase to process and store chats, and Microsoft Azure OpenAI to generate replies from your messages and selected context.
Guest chats are deleted after 30 days of inactivity. You can delete chats or revoke consent at any time.
Gradey shares only a limited snapshot of your marks and timetable needed to answer. It never shares your school password.

General chat sends your messages and relevant chat history, without automatically attaching school data. Other actions share the subjects, lessons, events and summaries shown in your selection. Test notes are shared only if you turn on “Include notes for this test”.

Messages and the selected school context are sent to the AI service. You can delete saved chats or withdraw consent in AI settings. School passwords and sign-in tokens are never included in the AI context.
Gradey AI is an artificial intelligence system. Before you start, review how it handles your information.
Gradey AI is an artificial intelligence system, not a person. Replies are generated automatically (EU AI Act, Art. 50).
Choose a subject or test before sending.
Tomorrow at a glance · no Compute used

Support includes 10 Compute each day; Support Plus includes 25. The daily allowance resets at midnight UTC.
Check your connection and try again.
Google Firebase and Microsoft Azure OpenAI process your messages, relevant chat history and selected school information to provide AI replies.
This withdraws your AI consent and permanently deletes all your Gradey AI chats. You’ll need to give consent again to use Gradey AI.

Connect your school account in the live app to make study plans, understand topics, and ask about your marks. Demo mode never sends questions or school data.
